These are not blocked attempts; they executed successfully.

4. **Corroborating history**: ALERT-5001 (earlier scan from same IP 192.0.2.66) was concluded INCONCLUSIVE — the attacker was reconnoitering this host before successfully exploiting it.

**Falsifying checks performed**: No evidence of blocked/errored queries, no zero-row returns, no benign packet metadata. The attack clearly succeeded.
